seoTitle: Machine Speed vs Human Speed: The Widening Security Gap
seoDescription: Code ships in minutes, but security review still takes days. See why the gap keeps widening and how automation can close it while humans keep final approval.

seoTitle: The Layered Security Problem in Containers
seoDescription: Container security fails when layers are treated alone. See how vulnerabilities flow from source to build, registry and runtime, and why one fix is not enough.

seoTitle: The Library CVE Problem: Trusting Maintainers
seoDescription: Your containers run code from maintainers you have never met. See how unpaid upkeep, patch delays and transitive risk drive library CVE exposure.

seoTitle: The Illusion of the Single Artifact
seoDescription: A container image looks like one file but is a stack of layers with hidden dependencies. See why one flaw can break everything and why scanners miss part of it.

seoTitle: The Remediation Trap: Why Your CVE Fix Takes Months
seoDescription: A critical CVE is patched upstream in days, yet your containers stay exposed for months. See the four-stage delay chain behind slow remediation.

seoTitle: Case Study: The Shai-Hulud NPM Attack
seoDescription: A case study of a typosquatting attack on npm users: how a fake lodash package worked, how layered detection caught it and what the alerts teach teams.

seoTitle: How to Use VEX Documents to Suppress Non-Exploitable CVEs
seoDescription: Cut CVE alert fatigue with VEX. Learn the VEX formats, how to write statements for non-exploitable findings and how to plug VEX into your CI/CD pipeline.

seoTitle: Automated Attestation for Software Factories
seoDescription: Design an automated attestation pipeline for a software factory. See how signed attestations stop tampering, map to SLSA levels and fit your build architecture.

seoTitle: What Are Attestation-Based Admission Policies?
seoDescription: Signatures alone prove little. Learn how in-toto attestations and Kyverno admission policies verify build evidence before Kubernetes lets an image run.

seoTitle: Collecting Runtime Evidence From K8s Pods With eBPF
seoDescription: Collect runtime evidence from Kubernetes pods with eBPF. See prerequisites, performance trade-offs and how to turn kernel events into audit-ready signals.

seoTitle: Containers vs Virtual Machines: Key Differences
seoDescription: A VM boots a full operating system; a container shares the host kernel. Compare architecture, isolation, security, performance and density side by side.

seoTitle: Docker and the OCI Specification Explained
seoDescription: How Docker's format became the OCI standard. Learn the image, runtime and distribution specs, and why OCI compliance keeps your containers portable.

seoTitle: How Containers Interact With the Linux Kernel
seoDescription: Containers are isolated processes, not mini VMs. See how namespaces, cgroups v2, capabilities and seccomp work together and what it means for security.

seoTitle: Container Registries Compared: Top Options
seoDescription: Compare Docker Hub, ECR, GCR, ACR, Harbor and more. Learn what a registry does, how public, cloud and self-hosted options differ, and how to choose one.

seoTitle: Linux Packages in Containers: APK, APT and RPM
seoDescription: How APK, APT and RPM packages work inside container images. Learn package formats, what package managers do, how verification works and why build time matters.

seoTitle: Standard vs Distroless Images: Pros and Cons
seoDescription: Standard images ship far more than your app needs. Compare attack surface, debugging trade-offs and dev image variants to decide when distroless fits.

seoTitle: Pre-Build Stage Security: Securing Your Chain
seoDescription: Attackers strike before your build starts. Secure source repositories, dependencies, base images and lockfiles so compromised inputs never reach the compiler.

seoTitle: Container Images in CI/CD: Source to Production
seoDescription: Your pipeline now produces container images, not binaries. Learn pipeline architecture, build practice, tagging strategies and the registry as artifact store.

seoTitle: Kubernetes Manifests and Deployment Files Guide
seoDescription: A complete guide to Kubernetes manifests. Learn core resource types, deployment anatomy, pod spec options and how labels, selectors and annotations connect.

seoTitle: Helm Fundamentals for Kubernetes Users
seoDescription: Learn Helm, the package manager for Kubernetes. Cover core concepts, chart structure, installing charts and how templating simplifies complex deployments.

seoTitle: The AI/ML Container Stack Explained
seoDescription: Models, frameworks and runners each add risk to AI containers. See how the three layers combine and which hardening practices apply to AI workloads.

seoTitle: Learning Path: Container Security Foundations
seoDescription: A structured learning path covering container fundamentals, threats and hardening. Follow the modules to build a working foundation in container security.

seoTitle: Learning Path: FIPS and Federal Compliance
seoDescription: A learning path for teams selling to government. Covers the federal compliance landscape, FIPS 140-3 cryptography and DISA STIG compliance for containers.

seoTitle: Learning Path: From Vulnerable to Verified Containers
seoDescription: Move from unsigned, unscanned images to a verified supply chain. This learning path covers assessment, quick wins and image hardening, step by step.

seoTitle: Learning Path: Hardening Your Software Supply Chain
seoDescription: Defend every stage of your build. This learning path covers supply chain fundamentals, SBOMs, VEX contextualization and the controls that stop upstream attacks.

seoTitle: Learning Path: Securing AI/ML Workloads in Containers
seoDescription: ML workloads face threats traditional apps do not. This learning path covers data poisoning, ML data protection and model integrity inside containers.

seoTitle: What Is a Package Manager?
seoDescription: What a package manager does and why it matters for security. Learn common managers, direct vs transitive dependencies, lock files and dependency trees.

seoTitle: What Is a Software Library (Dependency)?
seoDescription: Libraries, packages and modules explained. Learn why libraries exist, how they are organized by language and why they widen your supply chain attack surface.

seoTitle: What Are Transitive Dependencies?
seoDescription: You declare a few libraries; your build pulls in hundreds. See how transitive dependencies form, how to visualize the tree and why depth creates security risk.

seoTitle: What Is Build Provenance?
seoDescription: Provenance records where an artifact came from and how it was built. Learn the in-toto framework, provenance vs attestation and how to generate provenance.

seoTitle: What Is SLSA? Supply-Chain Levels Explained
seoDescription: SLSA is a framework for proving where software came from. Learn the levels, build integrity components and why SLSA provenance matters for containers.

seoTitle: What Is VEX? Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange
seoDescription: VEX tells you which CVEs are actually exploitable in your product. Learn the four statement types, the OpenVEX format and how VEX differs from CVE and CVSS.

seoTitle: What Are Reproducible Builds?
seoDescription: Reproducible builds let you confirm an image matches audited source. See why builds differ, how to achieve reproducibility and which standards guide the effort.

seoTitle: What Is OPA? Open Policy Agent Explained
seoDescription: Open Policy Agent enforces security policy as code. Learn how OPA works, the Rego policy language and how Gatekeeper applies OPA rules inside Kubernetes.

seoTitle: What Is Compliance-as-Code?
seoDescription: Replace yearly audit scrambles with continuous checks. Learn the three layers of compliance-as-code and how to map frameworks to automated, testable controls.

seoTitle: Development vs Production Images: Complete Separation
seoDescription: Keep build tools out of production. Learn the specs for development and production images, the build pipeline between them and the multi-stage build pattern.

seoTitle: Zero-Trust Supply Chain: Principles and Implementation
seoDescription: Apply zero trust to software delivery. Learn the four pillars, the complete verification flow, implementation details and the policies that enforce each step.

seoTitle: AI Container Attack Surface: 5 Key Vectors
seoDescription: Five attack vectors that standard images cannot block in AI containers: shell access, path traversal, poisoned dependencies, model corruption and audit gaps.

seoTitle: Build Stage Security: Inside the Build Process
seoDescription: The build is where attackers inject code and tamper with compilers. Learn build isolation, injection risks, hermetic builds and multi-stage separation.

seoTitle: Code, Build-Time and Low-Level Security Explained
seoDescription: Image scanning misses the deepest risks. See how code flaws, build-time trust gaps and low-level system libraries create exposure that scanners cannot see.

seoTitle: How Vulnerabilities Propagate Across Layers
seoDescription: A published vulnerability travels from a maintainer's repository to your running container. Follow its timeline and transitive spread.

seoTitle: Container Security Maturity Model
seoDescription: A four-tier maturity model for container security, from reactive patching and minimal images to signed provenance and source-built, verified images.

seoTitle: Network Policies for Container Security
seoDescription: Kubernetes allows all pod traffic by default. Learn how to apply a default-deny baseline, per-app policies, DNS rules and monitoring exceptions.

seoTitle: FIPS 140-3: Frequently Asked Questions
seoDescription: Answers on when FIPS applies, how to implement it, technical details, compliance questions and troubleshooting for FIPS 140-3 in container environments.

seoTitle: FIPS Support in Programming Languages
seoDescription: How to use FIPS-validated cryptography in Go, Java, Python and Node.js. Compare language-specific approaches and what each runtime needs to stay compliant.

seoTitle: Post-Quantum Cryptography for Container Images
seoDescription: Prepare container images for the quantum threat. Learn the NIST post-quantum standards, why a hybrid approach is recommended and how to implement hybrid TLS.

seoTitle: DISA STIG: Military-Grade Container Hardening
seoDescription: Apply DISA STIG controls to containers. Compare STIG with CIS, review container and application controls, and start from a STIG-aligned Dockerfile template.

seoTitle: OpenSCAP: Automated Compliance Assessment and Hardening
seoDescription: Scan container images against CIS and STIG with OpenSCAP. Learn what it does, how to install it and how to run CIS Docker Benchmark and STIG scans.

seoTitle: Supply Chain Security Incident Response Playbook
seoDescription: A phase-by-phase playbook for supply chain incidents: scope, severity classification, triage, containment, eradication and recovery, with clear time targets.

seoTitle: CycloneDX SBOM: Supply Chain Security
seoDescription: Generate CycloneDX SBOMs for container images. Learn why SBOMs matter, how CycloneDX compares with SPDX, the JSON schema and practical generation examples.

seoTitle: End-to-End Provenance Chaining: Source to Deployment
seoDescription: Link provenance from source to deployment. See how source, build and SBOM attestations chain into one unbroken, verifiable record across a multi-stage pipeline.

seoTitle: In-Toto Attestation: Supply Chain Link Verification
seoDescription: Use in-toto to verify every step of your supply chain. Learn core concepts, how to generate attestations for build steps and how to create and verify layouts.
